sql: SELECT t.*, a.account_name, a.account_tier, a.duns_number, a.account_owner, a.owner_email, c.erp_customer_id, c.customer_name FROM service_tickets t JOIN crm_accounts a ON a.account_id=t.account_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.duns_number=a.duns_number WHERE t.ticket_id='SR-39881'
gated_sql: SELECT t.*, a.account_name, a.account_tier, a.duns_number, a.account_owner, a.owner_email, c.erp_customer_id, c.customer_name FROM service_tickets AS t JOIN crm_accounts AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN customers AS c ON c.duns_number = a.duns_number WHERE t.ticket_id = 'SR-39881' LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT at, event, actor, detail FROM ticket_events WHERE ticket_id='SR-39881' ORDER BY julianday(at)
